unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: No per-collective wire bytes: hardware traffic counters require a successful collector-specific probe that is unavailable; device_telemetry only samples device-wide NVML rates (probe observed 341-5664 KB/s outside workload) with native windows; logical per-rank payload 497,759,232 B (12x28,351,488 + 1x157,541,376) is not wire traffic.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: NVLink is not supported on the leased devices: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3; NCCL channels were observed as SHM/direct/direct with peer access disabled in both directions, so no NVLink byte counts are obtainable.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: No hardware-counter probe available; NVML gpu/memory utilization readings are device-wide with device-dependent sampling windows, not scoped to operators or collectives.
unavailable_fields.communication_wire_time_ms: NCCL kernel durations include device waiting (parent discovery: rank0 192.99 ms vs rank1 33.22 ms for the same 13 collectives); no available collector separates waiting from transfer, nsys timelines alone cannot, and collective_calibration is a separate warmed reference experiment, not in-step wire or critical-path time.
unavailable_fields.per_bucket_cost_ms: Bucket membership is many-to-many (13 observed buckets with matched parameter inventory); no collector allocates a collective's cost among member parameter groups, and exact bucket links require native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership, which nsys alone does not provide.

collection_plan.rationale: Target revision is the sole listed candidate bbe28c40885890ef6d2c1e69bb75f1a6934178494d9d704ab56b0887e76301e6 (bundle fixed-observation-route): clean step_ms 54.35 vs paired parent 71.58, constraint passed, max-rank NCCL kernel sum 33.54/32.76 ms. Two observed uncertainties drive selection. (1) Route fidelity: the candidate declares graph_setup_capture (x1) and parent_eager_baseline (x1) on call 5d7d6bb13691b02f533f62b0 with 0 framework fallbacks, but these are candidate-reported labels; evaluation.json explicitly asks for native corroboration. nsys resolves the graph-tracing question natively (graph capture/launch evidence per invocation) plus candidate-side communication/compute overlap and kernel attribution left ambiguous by coverage (2984 root-only kernels, 52 ambiguous forward sequences); execution_timeline adds a separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals to distinguish a graph-replay submission pattern from eager launches without installing any communication hook; candidate_diagnostics supplies actual exception evidence (including handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations) for silent capture fallback - with the known limit that empty events do not establish which successful path executed. (2) Communication composition: parent discovery observed 13 f32 SUM allreduces (12x28,351,488 B + 1x157,541,376 B) entered via ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL over SHM/direct/direct with peer access disabled and only 7.8/2.0 ms compute overlap under intrusive profiling, and clean-run kernel sums still include device waiting. nccl_tuning captures the actual algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at these exact observed sizes/dtypes in a separate warmed worker (kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol); collective_calibration runs a correctness-checked synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the observed sizes as a reference to help distinguish algorithm cost from arrival skew/waiting - it is not a lower bound or critical-path estimate. Excluded: torch (already ran); device_telemetry (device-wide NVML windows, NVLink unsupported - cannot yield per-collective bytes; traffic dimensions listed unavailable); python_runtime (perturbs execution, no host-dispatch or binding cost question is evidenced, and its inclusive/self times are not clean scores); binding_cost (binding is direct with no functional replacements and no binding-overhead uncertainty is observed; per-call overhead on 2 candidate invocations is not a implicated step_ms component).
